T002.en: A remote Norwegian lodge. One week. A small group. Nature, movement and shared life.
T002.da: En afsides norsk lodge. Én uge. En lille gruppe. Natur, bevægelse og fælles liv.

T004.en: REFUGE61 sits above the treeline for those who come to move through the mountains by day and gather around the table by night.
T004.da: REFUGE61 ligger lige over trægrænsen — Det er et vintereventyr, det er langrend, naturoplevelser og så er det fællesskab på hytten, hvor vi samles om bordet om aftnen.

T010.en: Each day begins outside. Ski, walk, explore — at your own pace, together with the group or alone. No programme to complete, no performance to prove. Just the pleasure of moving through a vast winter landscape.
T010.da: Hver dag begynder udenfor. Stå på ski, gå en tur, udforsk — i dit eget tempo, sammen med gruppen eller alene. Der er intet program, der skal gennemføres, ingen præstationer. Det handler om at komme ud i det smukke Norske vinterlandskab.

T013.en: Life at REFUGE61 happens around the table. We cook together, share the meal, open a bottle, talk and laugh. There is no staff behind the scenes — everyone takes part in making the house come alive.
T013.da: Livet på REFUGE61 udspiller sig omkring bordet. Vi laver mad sammen, deler måltidet, åbner en flaske, taler og ler. Der er intet personale bag kulisserne — alle er med til at gøre huset levende.

T016.en: A week away from schedules, noise and everyday routines. Time to slow down, read, sit by the fire, step outside or simply do nothing. Sometimes, a little distance is all we need.
T016.da: En uge væk fra skemaer, støj og hverdagens rutiner, hvor der er tid til at sætte tempoet ned, læse, sidde ved ilden, gå udenfor eller bare gøre ingenting. Det er Norsk hyttehygge

T019.da: Nogle dage er gode til længere ture.

T020.en: When conditions allow, we leave the lodge for a longer journey into the mountains — on skis, on foot, carrying what we need for the day. Not a race and not a performance. Simply the pleasure of going somewhere together.
T020.da: Når forholdene tillader det, er der mulighed for længere dagsture ind i fjellene. Når madpakken er smurt og der er lidt varmt i thermokanden, så er det bare ud over vidderne med det vi har brug for til dagen. En fantastisk fælles oplevelse, hvor turen og samværet er målet, ikke farten.

T022.en: Write to us, and we'll reply personally.
T022.da: Skriv til os, så svarer vi personligt.

T025.en: A warm and comfortable home in the Norwegian mountains
T025.da: En varm, historisk og komfortabel storhytte i de norske fjelde

T026.en: For the week, the lodge will be our home — a place to relax, share meals and enjoy time together after a day in the mountains.
T026.da: I løbet af ugen bliver lodgen vores hjem — et sted til at slappe af, dele måltider og nyde tiden sammen efter en aktiv dag i vinterlandskabet.

T027.en: The atmosphere is warm, authentic and relaxed — more a private mountain home than a hotel.
T027.da: Stemningen er varm, autentisk og afslappet — Den nordiske hygge går vi efter.

T029.en: Set in the Norwegian mountains and surrounded by snow and nature, the lodge feels wonderfully removed from everyday life.
T029.da: Beliggende i de norske fjelde, omgivet af sne og natur bliver lodgen et eventyr, der skiller sig ud fra de flestes hverdag.

T030.en: There are no crowds and no hotel corridors — just the silence of winter, open space and the feeling of having a mountain home to ourselves.
T030.da: I logden er der kun os— vinterens stilhed, det åbne landskab og oplevelsen af at bo langt væk fra stress og jag.

T033.en: Accommodation is arranged in comfortable rooms for a maximum of two people.
T033.da: Indkvarteringen sker i de smukke værelser med plads til højst to personer.

T034.en: There are no dormitories. Everyone has a proper room in which to rest and recharge after a day outside.
T034.da: Der er 5 smukke værelser i grundplan og 2 flotte gavlværelser på 1 sal.

T035.en: The bedrooms are simple, warm and in keeping with the character of the lodge.
T035.da: Værelserne er enkle, varme og i tråd med lodgens karakter.

T038.en: After a day in the snow, the sauna is the perfect place to slow down, warm up and relax.
T038.da: Efter en dag i sneen er saunaen det perfekte sted at falde til ro, blive varm og slappe af.

T039.en: And for those who want the full Nordic experience, step outside afterwards into the crisp winter air and snow — before heading back into the warmth.
T039.da: Og for dem, der vil have den fulde nordiske oplevelse: Hop i sneen og mærk den den skarpe vinterluft — Og så tilbage i saunaen.

T040.en: A simple ritual, and one of the pleasures of life in the Norwegian mountains.
T040.da: Det er en lækker måde at runde en aktiv dag af på.

T042.da: Glæden ved at lave mad sammen

T043.en: The lodge has a large, fully equipped kitchen, designed for preparing meals together.
T043.da: Lodgen har et stort, fuldt udstyret køkken, indrettet til at lave mad sammen.

T044.en: Cooking is part of the experience — informal, convivial and shared. Some evenings we cook together, talk, have a drink and simply enjoy being there.
T044.da: Madlavningen er en del af oplevelsen — og i små hold laver vi mad til de andre. Så forvent 1 eller 2 dage hvor du deltager i madlavningen - Vi har en plan og et godt glas vin.

T047.en: The large dining room is where everyone comes together.
T047.da: Den store spisestue er der, hvor alle mødes.

T048.en: Breakfast before heading outside, dinner after a day in the snow, a bottle of wine, long conversations around the table — these shared moments are an important part of the week.
T048.da: Morgenmad før man tager ud, aftensmad efter en dag i sneen, måske et godt glas vinflaske vin, samtaler omkring bordet —

T051.en: After skiing, snowshoeing or simply spending the day outdoors, there is nowhere better to end the day than around the fire.
T051.da: Efter ski, snesko eller blot en dag udendørs findes der ingen bedre måde at slutte dagen på end omkring ilden.

T052.en: A drink, a book, a conversation — or simply doing nothing for a while.
T052.da: Et glas, en bog, en samtale, en lur - man kan gøre lige det man har lyst til.

T053.da: ALT HVAD VI HAR BRUG FOR

T054.en: The lodge offers generous shared spaces, a fully equipped kitchen, a large dining room, comfortable living areas and everything we need to make it our home for the week.
T054.da: Lodgen har rummelige fællesarealer, et fuldt udstyret køkken, en stor spisestue, komfortable opholdsrum og alt, hvad der skal til for at gøre den til vores hjem i en uge.

T056.en: The lodge is warm, comfortable and practical. What it deliberately does not offer is hotel service, passive consumption or a programme built around you.
T056.da: Lodgen er varm, eventyrlig, autentisk og komfortabel. Vi har ikke hotelservice, men tilgængæld hjemmelig hygge.

T059.en: Four weeks. A small number of guests (maximum of 14)

T060.en: REFUGE61 will welcome guests for four weeks in winter 2027, from Saturday to Saturday:
T060.da: REFUGE61 tager imod gæster i fire uger i vinteren 2027, fra lørdag til lørdag:

T065.en: Each stay is for seven nights.

T067.en: Remote, but surprisingly easy to reach.
T067.da: Afsides, men overraskende let at nå.

T068.en: Fly to Oslo Airport (Gardermoen). The railway station is located directly inside the airport.
T068.da: Flyv til Oslo Lufthavn (Gardermoen). Togstationen ligger inde i selve lufthavnen.

T069.en: Direct trains on the Dovre Line run north from Oslo Airport to Vinstra, with a journey time of approximately three hours.
T069.da: Direkte tog på Dovrebanen kører nordpå fra Oslo Lufthavn til Vinstra med en rejsetid på cirka tre timer.

T070.en: We will meet you at Vinstra station and take you the rest of the way to REFUGE61.
T070.da: Vi møder dig på Vinstra station og kører dig det sidste stykke til REFUGE61.

T071.en: We will provide recommended train times for each REFUGE61 week before your journey.
T071.da: Vi sender anbefalede togtider for hver REFUGE61-uge inden din rejse.

T072.en: No need to travel into Oslo. No car is needed.
T072.da: Du behøver ikke tage ind til Oslo. Der er ikke brug for bil.

T075.en: The lodge is made for shared living. Bedrooms are for two people, with a washbasin in each room. Toilets are available on every floor.
T075.da: Lodgen er indrettet til fælles liv. Værelserne er til to personer med håndvask på hvert værelse. Der er toiletter på hver etage.

T076.en: Showers and the sauna are in a separate building, just a few metres from the main lodge.
T076.da: Bad og sauna ligger i en separat bygning, blot få meter fra hovedbygningen.

T077.en: Bed linen and towels are provided.
T077.da: Sengelinned og håndklæder stilles til rådighed.

T080.en: Meals are part of the REFUGE61 experience. We prepare, cook and eat together, with small teams naturally taking turns in the kitchen.
T080.da: Måltiderne er en del af REFUGE61-oplevelsen. Vi forbereder, laver mad og spiser sammen, hvor små hold naturligt skiftes til at stå i køkkenet.

T081.en: There is no restaurant and no room service. Participation is part of what makes the week different.
T081.da: Der er ingen restaurant og ingen roomservice. Deltagelsen er en del af det, der gør ugen anderledes.

T083.en: 650 kilometres of tracks. Twenty metres from the lodge.
T083.da: 650 kilometer spor. Tyve meter fra lodgen.

T084.en: Just 20 metres from REFUGE61, you can step onto a groomed cross-country ski trail, prepared for both classic and skating.
T084.da: Stor set lige uden for døren er der preparede langrendsspor, klargjort til både klassisk og skøjting.

T085.en: From there, the trail connects to a network of around 650 kilometres of cross-country ski tracks.
T085.da: Herfra er der adgang til et spornet på omkring 650 kilometer langrendsspor.

T086.en: No transfer. No car. No timetable. Just put on your skis and go — with others or alone, for an hour or for the day.
T086.da: Skiiene skal bare på lige uden for hytten og kom afsted — sammen med andre eller alene, i en time eller hele dagen.

T089.en: There is no timetable to follow. We have breakfast, look outside, talk about the weather and snow conditions — and decide.
T089.da: Der er ingen tidsplan at følge. Vi spiser morgenmad, kigger ud, taler om vejret og sneforholdene — og beslutter os.

T090.en: Some may ski together, others may head out alone. The important thing is to be outside, move and enjoy the landscape at your own rhythm.
T090.da: Nogle står måske på ski sammen, andre tager afsted alene. Det vigtige er at være ude, bevæge sig og nyde landskabet i sit eget tempo.

T091.en: Later, we come back to the lodge, cook together and gather around the table.
T091.da: Senere vender vi tilbage til lodgen, laver mad sammen og samles om bordet.

T093.da: Mulighed for overnatningstur i lavuu eller snehule

T094.en: During the week, when weather and snow conditions allow, we plan an optional expedition into the mountains, with the possibility of spending a night away.
T094.da: I løbet af ugen planlægger vi — når vejr- og sneforhold tillader det — en frivillig ekspedition, med mulighed for en overnatning.

T095.en: Taking part is entirely your choice. Those who prefer to stay at the lodge or enjoy a different activity are completely free to do so.
T095.da: Hvis man har lyst til at blive på lodgen eller lave noget andet, er det også helt ok - men det er en fed oplevelse.

T096.en: The expedition is not a race or a test of performance. It is simply an opportunity to go further, carry what we need and experience the winter landscape differently.
T096.da: Mini-Ekspeditionen er en mulighed for at overnatte og opleve vinterlandskabet på en helt særlig måde. Vi nærmer os de basale behov om at være varm, mæt og tør.

T099.en: You don’t need to be an athlete. But you should enjoy being outside, moving and spending several hours in a winter environment.
T099.da: Du skal kunne lide at være udendørs, bevæge dig. Det at være fysisk aktiv er en stor del af turen - man bliver så dejligt træt

T100.en: REFUGE61 is about finding your own rhythm — sometimes with the group, sometimes alone.
T100.da: REFUGE61 handler om at finde sit eget tempo — nogle gange sammen med gruppen, nogle gange alene.

T101.en: It is neither a training camp nor a week spent entirely indoors.
T101.da: Det vigtigste er at man hygger sig og udfordrer sig selv inden for ens egen comfortzone

T103.da: Mere et spørgsmål om indstilling end om præstation.

T104.en: REFUGE61 has been created primarily for active adults over 50.
T104.da: REFUGE61 er primært skabt til aktive voksne over 50 år.

T105.en: We are looking for people who are curious, independent and happy to participate in shared life — people who enjoy being active outdoors but don’t need to turn every day into a performance.
T105.da: Dette er en mulighed for jer der er nysgerrige, selvstændige og glade for at deltage i et hyggeligt og aktivt fællesskab — jer, der kan lide at være udendørs, gerne vil forbedre jeres langrend og er du nybegynder - så lærer du det.

T106.en: The balance matters: movement, nature, freedom and time together.
T106.da: Balancen betyder noget: bevægelse, natur, frihed og tid sammen.

T108.en: Bring your own, or use ours.
T108.da: Tag dit eget grej med, eller brug vores.

T109.en: If you regularly practise cross-country skiing, we recommend bringing your own equipment — skis, boots and poles — so you can enjoy the week with the equipment you know best.
T109.da: Hvis du har eget udstyr, anbefaler vi, at du tager det med — ski, støvler og stave — så du kan nyde ugen med det udstyr, du kender bedst.

T110.en: For guests who don’t have their own equipment, Nordic skis, boots and poles will be available at REFUGE61 for the duration of the week.
T110.da: For gæster uden eget udstyr er der langrendsski, støvler og stave til rådighed på REFUGE61 i hele ugen.

T111.en: Bring good winter clothing and footwear suitable for cold conditions. Before your stay, we will send you a simple packing list.
T111.da: Medbring godt vintertøj og fodtøj, der egner sig til kulde. Inden dit ophold sender vi dig en enkel pakkeliste.

T114.en: The price includes seven nights at REFUGE61, all meals at the lodge, bed linen and towels, and Nordic skiing equipment (skis, boots and poles) for the duration of your stay.
T114.da: Prisen omfatter syv nætter på REFUGE61, alle måltider på lodgen, sengelinned og håndklæder samt langrendsudstyr (ski, støvler og stave) i hele opholdet.

T115.en: There is no online booking and no online payment.
T115.da: Der er hverken onlinebooking eller onlinebetaling.

T116.en: Before confirming any stay, Bjorn or Mathieu will have a personal conversation with you. We want to make sure that REFUGE61 matches what you are looking for — and that you match the spirit of the week.
T116.da: Før vi bekræfter et ophold, taler Bjorn eller Mathieu personligt med dig. Vi vil gerne sikre os, at REFUGE61 passer til det, du søger — og at du passer til ugens ånd.

T118.da: Rejs med den rette dækning. Vi er medlem af rejsegarantifonden

T119.en: Guests are responsible for having appropriate travel and medical insurance covering the winter activities they choose to take part in during their stay.
T119.da: Gæster er selv ansvarlige for at have en passende rejse- og sygeforsikring, der dækker de vinteraktiviteter, de vælger at deltage i under opholdet.

T121.da: Hvis dine planer skulle ændre sig

T122.en: Our cancellation conditions are designed to be clear and fair.
T122.da: Vores afbestillingsbetingelser er udformet, så de er klare og rimelige.

T123.en: Full details will be available in our Terms & Conditions and provided before any stay is confirmed.
T123.da: Alle detaljer findes i vores Vilkår og betingelser og udleveres, før et ophold bekræftes.

T125.en: THINK REFUGE61 MIGHT BE FOR YOU?
T125.da: TROR DU, REFUGE61 ER NOGET FOR DIG?

T126.da: Skriv eller ring for at høre mere

T127.en: Tell us a little about yourself, what brings you here and what you hope to find. Bjorn or Mathieu will then arrange a time to talk with you.
T127.da: Fortæl os lidt om dig selv, hvad der bringer dig hertil, og hvad du håber at finde. Bjorn eller Mathieu aftaler derefter et tidspunkt for en samtale med dig.

T130.en: Every stay at REFUGE61° begins with a conversation.
T130.da: Hvert ophold på REFUGE61° begynder med en samtale.

T131.en: REFUGE61 is a small, shared experience. There is no online booking and no automatic confirmation. Before you decide to come, we would simply like to meet you — and give you the opportunity to meet us.
T131.da: REFUGE61 er en lille, fælles oplevelse. Der er hverken onlinebooking eller automatisk bekræftelse. Før du beslutter dig for at komme, vil vi ganske enkelt gerne møde dig — og give dig mulighed for at møde os.

T133.en: I’m Bjørn Jacob Haugum – an outdoor guide, ultrarunner and entrepreneur with a passion for creating adventures and experiences for others.
T133.da: Jeg hedder Bjørn Jacob Haugum – friluftsguide, ultraløber og iværksætter med en passion for at skabe eventyr og oplevelser for andre.

T134.en: Through Bjørnen i bjergene and REFUGE61°, I create outdoor experiences that bring people closer to nature, to each other and to themselves. I have spent my whole life exploring the outdoors across the Nordic countries and feel particularly at home in winter landscapes.
T134.da: Gennem Bjørnen i bjergene og REFUGE61° skaber jeg friluftsoplevelser, der bringer mennesker tættere på naturen, på hinanden og på sig selv. Jeg har brugt hele mit liv på at udforske naturen i Norden og føler mig især hjemme i vinterlandskaber.

T135.en: I’m driven by creating the setting for truly memorable experiences in nature – and making them accessible to others.
T135.da: Det, der driver mig, er at skabe rammerne for virkelig mindeværdige oplevelser i naturen – og gøre dem tilgængelige for andre.

T137.en: I’m Mathieu Bonnier – an entrepreneur and lifelong outdoor enthusiast, with a particular love for winter, snow and remote places.
T137.da: Jeg hedder Mathieu Bonnier – iværksætter og friluftsentusiast hele livet, med en særlig forkærlighed for vinteren, sneen og afsides steder.

T138.en: For me, adventure is not about performance or going further than anyone else. It is about being outdoors, discovering new places, living simply and sharing good moments with the people around me.That is the spirit I hope to bring to REFUGE61°.
T138.da: For mig handler eventyr ikke om præstation eller om at komme længere end alle andre. Det handler om at være udendørs, opdage nye steder, leve enkelt og dele gode stunder med menneskene omkring mig. Det er den ånd, jeg håber at bringe til REFUGE61°.

T140.en: We come from different backgrounds and generations, but we share the same idea of what makes an adventure memorable: nature, simplicity, freedom and people.
T140.da: Vi kommer fra forskellige baggrunde og generationer, men vi deler den samme opfattelse af, hvad der gør et eventyr mindeværdigt: Natur, enkelhed, frihed og mennesker og fællesskab

T141.en: REFUGE61° grew from that shared vision.
T141.da: REFUGE61° er vokset ud af den fælles drøm og vision.

T142.en: REFUGE61° grew from that shared vision. It is not about following a programme or ticking boxes.
T142.da: REFUGE61° er skabt for at tilbyde en tur til Norge, hvor alt er planlagt. I skal bare komme og fylde rammerne ud - Vi har klaret alt planlægning.

T143.en: It is about living together for a few days in a special place, getting outside, sharing meals and experiences, and enjoying the rhythm of winter in the Norwegian mountains.
T143.da: Det handler om at leve sammen i nogle dage på et særligt sted, komme udenfor, dele måltider og oplevelser og nyde vinterens rytme i de norske fjelde.

T144.en: With REFUGE61°, we want to create the kind of week we would personally love to experience: simple, active and authentic, with time outdoors, good food, shared moments and the freedom to enjoy the mountains at your own pace.
T144.da: Med REFUGE61° har vi skabt den slags uge, vi selv ville elske at opleve: enkel, aktiv og autentisk, med tid udendørs, god mad, fælles stunder og friheden til at nyde fjeldene i sit eget tempo.

T146.da: DET HANDLER OM AT PASSE SAMMEN.

T147.en: The people matter as much as the place.
T147.da: Menneskene betyder lige så meget som stedet.

T148.en: REFUGE61 is for people who enjoy being active outdoors, but who also enjoy coming back, cooking together and sharing the evening.
T148.da: REFUGE61 er for mennesker, der kan lide at være aktive udendørs, men som også nyder at komme hjem, lave mad sammen og dele aftenen.

T149.en: It is neither a training camp nor a retreat spent entirely by the fire.
T149.da: Vi tager ture sammen eller finder samme i små grupper der passer til lyst og dagsform.

T150.en: There is no perfect profile. We simply want to make sure that what you are looking for matches what we have created.
T150.da: Alle er velkomne - nysgerrigheden og det positive mindset er det vigtigste.

T151.en: TELL US A LITTLE ABOUT YOURSELF.
T151.da: FORTÆL OS LIDT OM DIG SELV.

T158.en: We invite you to answer the questionnaire below, which is entirely optional. It is only intended to help us understand if REFUGE61 is right for you.
T158.da: Vi inviterer dig til at besvare spørgeskemaet nedenfor, som er helt frivilligt. Det er kun ment som en hjælp til at forstå, om REFUGE61 er det rigtige for dig.

T164.en: WHICH WEEK ARE YOU INTERESTED IN?
T164.da: HVILKEN UGE ER DU INTERESSERET I?

T170.da: Jeg er blot ved at undersøge mulighederne

T171.en: WHO WOULD YOU BE COMING WITH?

T176.en: WHAT ATTRACTS YOU MOST TO REFUGE61? *
T176.da: HVAD TILTRÆKKER DIG MEST VED REFUGE61? *

T177.en: Tell us in a few words what made you want to contact us.
T177.da: Fortæl os med få ord, hvad der fik dig til at kontakte os.

T178.en: HOW DO YOU IMAGINE YOUR DAYS AT REFUGE61?
T178.da: HVORDAN FORESTILLER DU DIG DINE DAGE PÅ REFUGE61?

T179.en: Select anything that feels right to you.
T179.da: Vælg alt det, der føles rigtigt for dig.

T185.en: A balance between time together and time on my own
T185.da: En balance mellem tid sammen og tid for mig selv

T186.en: HOW ACTIVE WOULD YOU LIKE YOUR STAY TO BE?
T186.da: HVOR AKTIVT ØNSKER DU, AT DIT OPHOLD SKAL VÆRE?

T187.en: Gentle — a few hours outside each day
T187.da: Roligt — et par timer udendørs hver dag

T188.en: Active — I enjoy being outdoors for much of the day
T188.da: Aktivt — jeg kan lide at være udendørs det meste af dagen

T189.en: Very active — long and physically demanding days are what I’m looking for
T189.da: Meget aktivt — lange og fysisk krævende dage er det, jeg søger

T190.en: ANYTHING ELSE YOU WOULD LIKE US TO KNOW?
T190.da: ER DER ANDET, DU GERNE VIL FORTÆLLE OS?

T191.en: Interests, expectations, dietary requirements, questions, etc.

T193.en: I agree that REFUGE61 may use the information provided in this form to respond to my enquiry and contact me about a possible stay. I have read the Privacy Policy.
T193.da: Jeg accepterer, at REFUGE61 må bruge de oplysninger, jeg har angivet i denne formular, til at besvare min henvendelse og kontakte mig om et muligt ophold. Jeg har læst Privatlivspolitikken.

T196.en: This is not a booking request. Bjorn or Mathieu will contact you personally to arrange a conversation.
T196.da: Dette er ikke en bookinganmodning. Bjorn eller Mathieu kontakter dig personligt for at aftale en samtale.

T197.en: YOU TELL US A LITTLE ABOUT YOURSELF.
T197.da: DU FORTÆLLER OS LIDT OM DIG SELV.

T200.en: Bjorn or Mathieu will contact you to arrange a video or phone conversation.
T200.da: Bjorn eller Mathieu kontakter dig for at aftale en video- eller telefonsamtale.

T202.en: If REFUGE61 feels right for everyone, we’ll explain how to confirm your stay.
T202.da: Hvis REFUGE61 føles rigtigt for alle, forklarer vi, hvordan du bekræfter dit ophold.

T205.en: REFUGE61 is primarily designed for active adults over 50 who enjoy nature, movement and shared experiences. You don’t need to be an athlete — curiosity, independence and the right mindset matter much more than performance.
T205.da: REFUGE61 er primært til aktive voksne over 50 år, som holder af natur, bevægelse og fælles oplevelser. Du behøver ikke være atlet — nysgerrighed, selvstændighed og den rette indstilling betyder langt mere end præstation.

T206.en: Do I need to be a good skier?
T206.da: Skal jeg være en god skiløber?

T207.en: No. You should enjoy being active outdoors, but REFUGE61 is not a training camp. Everyone is free to find their own rhythm, sometimes with the group and sometimes alone.
T207.da: Nej. Du skal kunne lide at være aktiv udendørs, men REFUGE61 er ikke en træningslejr. Alle er frit stillet til at finde deres eget tempo, nogle gange sammen med gruppen og nogle gange alene.

T208.en: Do I need to bring my own skis?
T208.da: Skal jeg medbringe mine egne ski?

T209.en: If you regularly practise cross-country skiing, we recommend bringing your own skis, boots and poles. You will probably be more comfortable using equipment you already know. If you don’t have your own equipment, Nordic skis, boots and poles will be available at REFUGE61 for the duration of the week.
T209.da: Hvis du jævnligt står på langrend, anbefaler vi, at du tager dine egne ski, støvler og stave med. Du vil sandsynligvis være mere tilpas med udstyr, du allerede kender. Har du ikke dit eget udstyr, står langrendsski, støvler og stave til rådighed på REFUGE61 i hele ugen.

T210.en: Do we have to do everything together?

T211.en: No. We live together, but that doesn’t mean doing everything together. You are free to join the group or spend time on your own.
T211.da: Nej. Vi bor sammen, men det betyder ikke, at vi laver alting sammen. Du er fri til at slutte dig til gruppen eller bruge tid for dig selv.

T212.da: Hvor kan vi stå på ski?

T213.en: A groomed cross-country ski trail passes just 20 metres from the lodge, prepared for both classic and skating. It connects directly to a network of around 650 kilometres of trails. You can simply put on your skis and go.
T213.da: Et præpareret langrendsspor går blot 20 meter fra lodgen, klargjort til både klassisk og skøjting. Det forbinder direkte til et net på omkring 650 kilometer spor. Du tager blot skiene på og kører.

T214.en: Do I have to join the mini-expedition?

T215.en: No. The expedition is entirely optional. When conditions allow, we may organise a longer journey into the mountains, possibly including a night away. Those who prefer to stay at the lodge or do something different are completely free to do so.
T215.da: Nej. Ekspeditionen er helt frivillig. Når forholdene tillader det, arrangerer vi måske en længere tur ind i bjergene, eventuelt med en overnatning. De, der foretrækker at blive på lodgen eller lave noget andet, er helt frit stillet.

T216.en: Do guests participate in preparing meals?

T217.en: Yes. We prepare, cook and eat together, with small teams naturally taking turns in the kitchen. Participation is part of the experience.
T217.da: Ja. Vi forbereder, laver mad og spiser sammen, hvor små hold naturligt skiftes til at stå i køkkenet. Deltagelsen er en del af oplevelsen.

T219.en: Bedrooms are for two people. Toilets are available on every floor. Showers and the sauna are in a separate building just a few metres away. Bed linen and towels are provided.
T219.da: Værelserne er til to personer. Der er toiletter på hver etage. Bad og sauna ligger i en separat bygning blot få meter væk. Sengelinned og håndklæder stilles til rådighed.

T220.en: How do I get to REFUGE61?

T221.en: Fly to Oslo Airport (Gardermoen). The railway station is directly inside the airport. Direct trains run north to Vinstra, in less than 3 hours, where we will meet our guests and take them the rest of the way to REFUGE61.
T221.da: Flyv til Oslo Lufthavn (Gardermoen). Togstationen ligger inde i selve lufthavnen. Direkte tog kører nordpå til Vinstra på under 3 timer, hvor vi møder vores gæster og kører dem det sidste stykke til REFUGE61.

T223.en: €1,800 per person for seven nights, including accommodation, meals at the lodge, bed linen and towels, and Nordic skiing equipment for the week.
T223.da: 1.800 € pr. person for syv nætter, inklusive indkvartering, måltider på lodgen, sengelinned og håndklæder samt langrendsudstyr for hele ugen.

T224.en: How do I reserve a place?

T225.en: There is no online booking. Complete the LET’S TALK questionnaire and Bjorn or Mathieu will contact you personally. If REFUGE61 feels right for everyone, we will then explain how to confirm your place.
T225.da: Der er ingen onlinebooking. Udfyld LAD OS TALE SAMMEN- spørgeskemaet, så kontakter Bjorn eller Mathieu dig personligt. Hvis REFUGE61 føles rigtigt for alle, forklarer vi derefter, hvordan du bekræfter din plads.

T230.en: REFUGE61 is a one-week winter experience in the Norwegian mountains, centred around cross-country skiing, nature, simplicity, community and life in a mountain lodge.

T231.en: The stay runs from Saturday to Saturday.

T232.en: REFUGE61 is neither a traditional hotel stay nor a classic guided ski holiday with a fixed daily programme. Guests and hosts live together at the lodge, share meals, cook together and spend their days cross-country skiing and enjoying the winter landscape.

T233.en: Guests are free to choose their own pace and activities. The hosts provide the framework for the week, advise on routes and possibilities, share practical tips on cross-country skiing and join selected outings.The week also includes the opportunity to take part in an optional mini-expedition, with one overnight stay in the winter mountains, subject to weather, snow and safety conditions.

T241.en: The specific dates are stated in the individual booking.

T242.en: The lodge has seven double rooms and accommodates up to 14 guests.

T243.en: Accommodation is normally based on two guests sharing a room.

T244.en: Solo travellers booking shared accommodation may be paired with another solo traveller. The applicable room arrangement will be made clear to the guest before the booking becomes binding.

T245.en: A private room may be booked for an additional charge, subject to availability.

T250.en: transport from Vinstra station to the lodge on arrival

T251.en: transport from the lodge to Vinstra station on departure

T255.en: relevant shared equipment for the mini-expedition

T261.en: Transport to and from Vinstra is not included.

T262.en: Guests must bring their own winter and ski clothing, ordinary clothing and footwear, personal medication and snacks.

T263.en: Beer, wine and other alcoholic beverages are not included. Guests may bring their own alcohol for moderate personal consumption.

T265.en: Guests are responsible for arranging their own transport to and from Vinstra.

T266.en: Before the trip, REFUGE61 will provide a recommended arrival time at Vinstra station. The shared transfer to the lodge is organised on the basis of this time.

T267.en: If a guest cannot arrive at the recommended time, alternative arrangements must be agreed with REFUGE61 in advance.

T268.en: The same principle applies on departure. REFUGE61 will provide a recommended departure time and arrange transport from the lodge to Vinstra station.

T269.en: Individual arrangements may be possible where practical.

T271.en: Breakfast, lunch and dinner are included.

T272.en: REFUGE61 is a shared experience rather than a traditional hotel stay. Preparing food, eating together and taking part in everyday life at the lodge are part of the concept.

T273.en: Guests are divided into small cooking teams of approximately three people. As a general rule, each team prepares one dinner and one breakfast during the week.

T274.en: We provide varied food and aim to offer sufficient choice for everyone to eat well.

T275.en: REFUGE61 does not normally prepare individual meals or separate menus tailored to specific dietary preferences or diets.

T276.en: Guests must inform REFUGE61 before the stay of any food allergy or dietary requirement that is important for us to know about. Guests with particular dietary needs are encouraged to contact us before booking so that the practical possibilities can be clarified.

T278.en: A deposit of 25% of the total price is payable at the time of booking.

T279.en: The remaining 75% must be paid no later than 60 days before the start of the trip.

T280.en: If the trip is booked less than 60 days before departure, the full price is payable at the time of booking.

T281.en: The booking becomes binding once REFUGE61 has received the required payment and the guest has received a booking confirmation.

T282.en: By booking, the guest accepts these Terms and Conditions of Travel.

T284.en: The guest may cancel the trip at any time before departure.

T285.en: The following standard cancellation fees apply:

T286.en: More than 90 days before departureNo cancellation fee. All amounts paid are refunded.

T287.en: 90 to 61 days before departureCancellation fee: 25% of the total price.

T288.en: 60 to 15 days before departureCancellation fee: 50% of the total price.

T289.en: 14 days or less before departureCancellation fee: 100% of the total price.

T290.en: If the guest has paid more than the applicable cancellation fee, REFUGE61 will refund the difference.

T291.en: Any refund will be made without undue delay and no later than 14 days after cancellation.

T292.en: Cancellation must be notified to REFUGE61 in writing.

T293.en: The standard cancellation fees are subject to mandatory package travel legislation. If mandatory law gives the guest a greater right to reimbursement, the statutory rules take precedence.

T295.en: Illness, injury, changes in employment circumstances or other personal circumstances affecting the guest do not in themselves alter the ordinary cancellation terms.

T296.en: REFUGE61 therefore strongly recommends appropriate cancellation insurance.

T298.en: If a guest is unable to participate, the trip may be transferred to another person who fulfils the conditions for participation, in accordance with the Danish Package Travel Act.

T299.en: REFUGE61 must be informed on a durable medium as early as possible before departure.

T300.en: Notification received no later than seven days before the start of the trip is considered to have been given within a reasonable time under the Danish Package Travel Act.

T301.en: REFUGE61 may charge the actual, documented and reasonable costs arising directly from the transfer.

T302.en: The original guest and the person taking over the trip remain responsible for outstanding payments and transfer-related costs to the extent provided by law.

T304.en: It is a condition of participation in REFUGE61 that the guest has relevant and adequate insurance throughout the journey and stay.

T305.en: As a minimum, the insurance must cover:

T309.en: the winter, skiing and outdoor activities in which the guest intends to participate.

T310.en: The guest is responsible for ensuring that the insurance applies to the activities included in the stay, including cross-country skiing and the mini-expedition with an overnight stay in the winter mountains.

T311.en: As part of the booking process, the guest will be asked to confirm that they understand and accept this insurance requirement and that adequate insurance will be in place before departure.

T312.en: REFUGE61 recommends that the guest's insurance also includes cancellation cover.

T313.en: REFUGE61 maintains relevant business and liability insurance for its own activities.

T315.en: REFUGE61 does not provide formal cross-country skiing instruction.

T316.en: The hosts share experience and practical tips, advise on routes and conditions and join selected outings.

T317.en: Guests decide for themselves which activities and outings they wish to take part in. There is no expectation that everyone follows the same programme or pace.

T318.en: Previous cross-country skiing experience is not required, but guests should be in normal physical condition and are responsible for assessing whether a chosen activity is appropriate for their own physical and technical ability.

T320.en: Guests are generally free to organise their own days and may go on ski outings without the hosts.

T321.en: For safety reasons, guests going out independently are strongly encouraged to inform the hosts or another person at the lodge of their planned route and expected return time.

T322.en: Each guest is responsible for choosing an outing appropriate to their own ability and the conditions on the day.

T323.en: REFUGE61 may recommend or advise against particular routes or activities based on weather, snow conditions, safety or other relevant circumstances.

T324.en: Cross-country skiing and travel in the winter mountains involve inherent risks. These inherent risks do not in themselves constitute a lack of conformity in the package.

T325.en: REFUGE61 remains responsible for the performance of the agreed travel services and for injury or loss to the extent required by applicable law.

T326.en: Nothing in these terms excludes or limits any liability or right that cannot legally be excluded or restricted to the detriment of the guest.

T328.en: During the week, guests are offered a mini-expedition with one overnight stay in the winter mountains.

T330.en: The mini-expedition takes place together with the hosts and is facilitated by REFUGE61. Relevant shared expedition equipment is provided.

T331.en: The route, timing, overnight location and final format depend on the prevailing weather, temperature, snow and safety conditions.

T332.en: The hosts may therefore change the route, timing or activity or, where necessary, decide that the mini-expedition cannot take place as originally planned.

T333.en: 14. Weather and Changes to the Programme

T334.en: REFUGE61 takes place in the winter mountains, where changing weather and snow conditions are part of the experience.

T335.en: Specific routes, snow conditions or activities on particular days therefore cannot be guaranteed.

T336.en: Minor changes to routes, activities and the practical programme may be made where circumstances require, particularly for reasons of weather, snow conditions or safety.

T337.en: If a change constitutes a significant change to an agreed travel service or a lack of conformity in the package, the traveller's rights under applicable package travel legislation apply.

T339.en: Guests must normally be at least 18 years old to participate independently.

T340.en: Young people aged 16 or over may participate when accompanied by a responsible adult.

T341.en: REFUGE61 is based on community, freedom, trust and mutual respect. Guests are expected to behave responsibly and considerately towards other guests, the hosts, the lodge and nature.

T342.en: The lodge and surrounding area are smoke-free.

T343.en: Alcohol may be consumed in moderation and with due consideration for the community, safety and planned activities.

T345.en: Included ski and expedition equipment is made available to guests during the stay.

T346.en: Guests are expected to treat the equipment responsibly and follow reasonable instructions concerning its use.

T347.en: Ordinary wear and tear and accidental damage do not in themselves give rise to a compensation claim against the guest.

T348.en: In cases of intentional damage or damage caused by grossly irresponsible treatment, the guest may be held liable for the documented loss in accordance with applicable law.

T350.en: REFUGE61 operates the trip regardless of the number of guests booked. There is no minimum participant requirement.

T351.en: If REFUGE61 cancels the entire trip, all amounts paid by the guest to REFUGE61 will be refunded without undue delay and no later than 14 days after cancellation.

T352.en: The guest's remaining rights are governed by applicable package travel legislation.

T353.en: Illness or absence of one of the hosts does not in itself result in cancellation if the stay can still be carried out safely and properly with the other host.

T355.en: The rules of the Danish Package Travel Act apply in the event of unavoidable and extraordinary circumstances.

T356.en: If such circumstances at the destination or in its immediate vicinity significantly affect the performance of the package or the transport of passengers to the destination, the guest has the cancellation, refund and other rights provided by applicable law.

T357.en: 19. Travel Guarantee Fund, Travel Documents and Problems During the Stay

T358.en: Before selling and operating trips for which registration is required, REFUGE61 will be registered with the Danish Travel Guarantee Fund (Rejsegarantifonden).

T359.en: Once registration is complete, the relevant registration details will be inserted here.

T360.en: Guests are responsible for holding a valid passport and any other necessary travel documents.

T361.en: Before the contract is concluded, REFUGE61 will provide any passport, visa and health information that the organiser is legally required to provide.

T362.en: If a problem arises during the stay, the guest must contact REFUGE61 or the hosts as soon as reasonably possible so that REFUGE61 has the opportunity to investigate and, where possible, remedy the problem.

T363.en: The guest's statutory rights remain unaffected.

T365.en: The trip is organised by a Danish company and is governed by Danish law.

T366.en: Where the trip is subject to the Danish Act on Package Travel and Linked Travel Arrangements, its mandatory provisions apply regardless of the wording of these terms.

T367.en: The choice of Danish law does not limit any protection available to a consumer under mandatory rules applicable to the contract.
